title: KYA HAAL HO RAZAA KE JIGAR BAND KA BAYAAN
body:
ibn-e raza bhi saalike raahe raza rahaa
sajjada-e rasool pe shaghle dua rahaa
har ranj me zabaan pa shukr-e khuda rahaa
ginti ke dostdaar the dushman hazaarhaa
<<MINI>>
badh khwaah kitne is qamar-e murtuza ke the
tha ek chiraagh sainkdo jhonke hawa ke the
<<DIVIDER>>
kya haal ho razaa ke jigar band ka bayaa'n
pyaara tha murtuza ka wo sultan-e ins-o jaa'n
moujiz numa imaam-e zama'n haadiye jahaa'n
aise wali ke dar paye eezaa the badh-gumaa'n
<<MINI>>
souz-e alam se dil me the chaale pade huwe
the rashke gul ko jaan ke laale pade huwe
<<DIVIDER>>
laanath quda ki motasim e naabekaar par
bheja payaam chodiye ghar aayiye udhar
darpesh aah phir huwa baghdaad ka safar par is safar ne manzil-e aaqir ki di qabar
mazloom ka ye kooch watan se aqeer tha
mushtaaq-e kanj qabr ka wo goshageer tha
<<DIVIDER>>
hamraah umme fazl bhi thi moride azaab
yasrab se jaane ki thi qushi isko be hisaab
uska chacha tha motasim-e qaanumaa’n qaraab
baghdaad me pahonch gaye shaah-e falak janaab
touqeer zaaheri to bahut bewafaa ne ki par fikr-e qatl-e shaah is ahl-e jafaa ne ki
<<DIVIDER>>
baghdaad me muqeem rahe saal bhar huzoor
naari ye chaahta tha ke gul ho charaagh-e noor
waaqif tha umme fazl ki haalat se pur futoor
rakhti thi bughz rahbar-e aalam se be shaoor
<<MINI>>
zaalim ke mashvare se wo qarsand hogayi
kehne pe motasim ke raza mand hogayi
<<DIVIDER>>
ye be murawwati ye sitam ye ghazab ye qahar
wo bekasi imaam ki wo door apna shaher
dekhe to ahle dil qalash e qaar baagh-e dahar
angoor raazaqi me diya faaqakash ko zehar
<<MINI>>
li karwate'n ali-o wali ko pukaar ke
eezaa-e paak sooj gaye dil figaar ke
<<DIVIDER>>
rone lagi wo dekh ke hazrat ka haal-e zaar
farmaaya aap ne ke abas hai to ashkbaar
is aarze se degaa sazaa tujhko kirdegaar
jis ka koi ilaaj nahi aye jafaa shiyaar
<<MINI>>
deti jawaab kya sar-e mal'oona jhuk gaya
dam shaahe dee'n ka zaher ke sadmou se ruk gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
takleef payi chand shab-o roz jaa'n gasal
taasir-e sam se aag thi seene me mushta'al
wo karb wo jigar ki haraarat wo dard-e dil
hota gaya rasool ka dildaar muzmahil
<<MINI>>
haakim ne ki madad na tawajjo tabeeb ne
aaqir safar kiya suwe jannat ghareeb ne
<<DIVIDER>>
kumbhla ke rehgaya gule tar buturaab ka
murjhaya nounehaal risaalat ma'aab ka
dekha jawaane marg ne rang inqilaab ka
wo maut bekasi ki wo mausam shabaab ka
<<MINI>>
kyu peer e charq jaaye taa saf hai ya nahi
kamsin imaamo'n me koi aisa huwa nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
anjaam is tarha bhi kitaabo'n me hai raqam
shiyo'n ne aap ke jo suna ye naya sitam
rote huwe gaye sar-e tasleem karke qam
mayyat ko behre ghusl uthaya ba chashme nam
<<MINI>>
seeno'n ko apne qasta jigar peetne lage
amaame phaink phaink ke sar peetne lage
<<DIVIDER>>
nahlaaya is musaafir-e daarus salaam ko
bhar aaye dil kafan jo pinhaaya imaam ko
taaboot me litaake shah-e qaas-o aam ko
pursa diya ali ko rasool-e anaam ko
<<MINI>>
naale tawaaf karte the arshe majeed ka
maatam kiya uthaake janaaza shaheed ka
<<DIVIDER>>
jis jaa thi qabr moosiye kaazim falak weqaar
pehlu me is lahad ke quda doosra mazaar
posheeda zer-e qaak huwa noor-e kirdegaar
hasrat pukaar ti thi ke is shaan ke nisaar
<<MINI>>
taaqeere dafn se bhi sharaf aashkaar hai
ye waaris-e hussain ghareeb ud dayaar hai
